mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_dept (parent_dept_no, dept_no, dept_name, sort_no, data_state, create_time, create_by, leader_id, remark) VALUES (#{parentDeptNo}, #{deptNo}, #{deptName}, #{sortNo}, #{dataState}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, #{leaderId}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dept SET parent_dept_no = #{parentDeptNo}, dept_name = #{deptName}, sort_no = #{sortNo}, data_state = #{dataState}, leader_id = #{leaderId}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id} AND update_time = #{oldUpdateTime} AND update_time IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_dept_no, dept_no, dept_name, sort_no, data_state, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, leader_id, remark FROM `sys_dept` WHERE data_state = '0' ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC
